findings.actual: The helper copies the ZIP before its first receipt observation. ReadAll returns the temporary receipt’s bytes and file identity, but the helper never compares that identity. The check after the read examines only the ZIP, whose original identity has returned. The final receipt check runs only for an initially absent receipt. A genuine clean receipt for identical ZIP bytes therefore passes current-provenance validation, and Begin or Reinstall records frozen-candidate for the restored source path.
findings.blocking_rationale: Default staging can grant frozen-candidate provenance to a selected pair that is refused when read undisturbed. Removing the folder-wide check exposed this case on the receipt-present path.
findings.expected: Default staging validates the receipt belonging to the selected external ZIP or refuses the ambiguous pair.
findings.requested_correction: Capture the adjacent receipt’s identity and bytes when selecting the external ZIP and carry that observation through the ZIP copy. Check that the receipt read belongs to the selected pair before accepting the snapshot. Keep the stability checks specific to those two files.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend the existing external-pair fixture with two independent copies of the same ZIP. Establish that the clean pair qualifies and the dirty pair is refused. Record the distinct receipt identities and show that restoring the dirty pair across a successful read of the other receipt results in refusal.
findings.title: External staging can qualify a ZIP with another pair’s receipt
findings.trigger: A dirty external pair moves away after the ZIP identity check. A second pair with byte-identical ZIP contents and a clean receipt occupies the paths during the receipt read. The original pair returns before the next ZIP identity check.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Gate line 177 observed hasReceipt=False, restored the original dirty pair with the directory timestamp preserved, and recorded refusal because the receipt had reappeared. The helper now rechecks an initial absence before returning content-only staging.

The staging decision no longer uses the directory timestamp. Gate line 178 created and renamed unrelated siblings while the copy was paused. The helper returned external-content-inspected with the expected ZIP digest.
